noticia: Porzingis (undisclosed) won't travel with the Warriors and remains out indefinitely, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

Ighodaro (hip) didn't return to Wednesday's 124-83 loss to Portland, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports. He finished with eight points (4-7 FG, 0-2 FT), three rebounds and three assists over 15 minutes.
Youngblood is out for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Phoenix due to left ankle soreness.

Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work but is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.

titular: To miss at least two weeks
noticia: Cardwell will miss at least two weeks with a left calf strain, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Coward chipped in seven points (3-6 FG, 1-2 3Pt), seven rebounds, two assists and one block across 28 minutes during Wednesday's 123-103 win over the Jazz.
Awaka (knee) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
Monk (ankle) is probable for Friday's game against Portland.
Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.
Collins (quadriceps) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
Knueppel (hamstring) has returned to individual on-court activity but won't play in Wednesday's game against the Nets.

donde: Me la pela un poco JAJAJAJJAJALOVER
titular: Shut down for rest of season
noticia: Niederhauser has been diagnosed with a Lisfranc injury in his right foot and will require surgery. He's been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
Stewart (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Jazz.
